method: Primary public product, documentation, enterprise, and business-contact pages only. Fit is a hypothesis, not demand.

prospects.fit_hypothesis: LM Studio runs llama.cpp GGUF models and sells enterprise deployment; a reversible GGUF diagnostic may fit evaluation or partner work.
prospects.disqualifier: LM Studio may consider this internal capability, competition, or outside current priorities; budget and interest are unmeasured.

prospects.fit_hypothesis: Ollama documents GGUF import and offers enterprise deployment planning and support; model diagnostics may fit partner or support-adjacent work.
prospects.disqualifier: Ollama may perform this work internally; no posted project, budget, or request for model editing was observed.

prospects.fit_hypothesis: Jan publicly supports community GGUF models and publishes a business-inquiry route; a bounded reversible diagnostic may fit model evaluation or partnership work.
prospects.channel: official business-inquiry address published on the support page
prospects.disqualifier: Jan is open source and may not have a procurement need or budget for this service; interest is unmeasured.

prospects.fit_hypothesis: AnythingLLM offers local-model integrations and enterprise on-premise customization; a GGUF diagnostic may fit customer-specific local-model evaluation.
prospects.disqualifier: AnythingLLM may route model behavior to upstream runtimes and may not control a target GGUF; no budget or request was observed.

distribution_sequence: Publish diagnostic.html and the exact offer/terms hash.
Use the official enterprise or business route only after the owner reviews the public draft.
Ask for a legally controlled GGUF, runnable harness, and one technical owner before any private file exchange.
Record an exact public purchase-intent post before generating a receipt.
Move NDA, SOW, customer bytes, and processor invoice to owner-private hosted surfaces.
